items.instructions: Choose the word that matches each definition.

items.prompt: the title of a news story, printed in large letters

explanation.en: A headline is the title at the top of a news story.

items.prompt: a programme sent out on television or radio

explanation.en: A broadcast is a programme sent out on TV or radio.

items.prompt: a regular payment that gives you a magazine or an online service

explanation.en: You pay a subscription to receive something regularly.

items.prompt: official control over what people may publish or say

explanation.en: Censorship is when authorities stop information from being published.

items.prompt: a film that presents real facts about a subject

explanation.en: A documentary is about real events and people, not fiction.

items.instructions: Complete each sentence with the best word.

items.prompt: The match is on a different ___ tonight; try number seven.

explanation.en: A channel is a TV station.

items.prompt: Did you see last night's ___ of that crime drama?

explanation.en: An episode is one programme in a series.

items.prompt: There was an interesting ___ about robots in today's paper.

explanation.en: An article is a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.

items.prompt: The ___ for the new trainers comes on between every programme.

explanation.en: An advert (advertisement) tries to sell a product.

items.prompt: She wrote a glowing ___ of the film for the local paper.

explanation.en: A review gives an opinion about a film, book or show.

items.instructions: Choose the word that is most often used with the words on the left.

items.prompt: breaking …

explanation.en: Breaking news is news that has just happened.

items.prompt: the front …

explanation.en: The front page is the most important page of a newspaper.

items.prompt: hold a press …

explanation.en: A press conference is a meeting where journalists ask questions.

items.prompt: go …

explanation.en: Something goes viral when it spreads very fast online.

items.prompt: write a weekly … for a newspaper

explanation.en: A column is a regular article by the same writer.

items.instructions: Choose the word that is closest in meaning to the word on the left.

items.prompt: one-sided

explanation.en: Partisan means strongly supporting one side. Objective has the opposite meaning.

items.prompt: invented

explanation.en: A fabricated story has been made up in order to deceive.

items.prompt: attention-grabbing

explanation.en: Sensational reporting is designed to shock or excite readers.

items.prompt: trustworthy

explanation.en: A credible source is one that can be believed.

items.prompt: to spread (information) widely

explanation.en: To disseminate information is to send it out to many people.
